description: Get a payment link to register a domain and put it on one of your sites. The HUMAN opens and pays it; you never can. The payment page also asks for the domain owner's name, address and phone. After payment the domain is registered here and goes live on that site automatically, with HTTPS and no DNS settings. Only for sites on the user's account. For an anonymous site, give the human the claim link first. Never buy anything without asking me. Never buy a domain, email or subscription for me without asking first. When something costs money, give me the payment link and let me pay.

extras.description: Optional extra domain names on the same payment.

site.description: The address of the site the domain should attach to (from list_sites).
